str: An advanced technology, two-component, moisture-cured, zinc-rich primer providing extraordinary performance. It’s user
friendly and rapid curing so chemical- and corrosion-resistant topcoats can be applied the “same-day.” Also used for field
touch-up of inorganic zinc coating. Application methods include “dry-fall” under certain conditions (see Application).
